study.question: Does within-group action/fine-recency association add predictive utility beyond separate group fine-age distributions and action/coarse-age tables, while retaining the cheaper summary model training-cost advantage?
study.hypothesis: The local_product representation adds mean action and fine-age embeddings, so it cannot distinguish action/fine-age couplings within a coarse-age stratum when its retained margins coincide. A compact diagonal action-by-fine-age moment may recover useful relationships at lower cost than frozen joint_identity. The paired conditional-marginal replacement tests that association rather than merely the presence of an extra nonlinear readout. This is a hypothesis from source-level non-identifiability plus preliminary local temporal contrasts, not an established source of the observed performance gap.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit embedding MLP and target-dependent aggregation ideas; use fixed category/brand match partitions and exact count tables, without learned per-event attention. Test action/fine-age association through a within-coarse conditional-product replacement. DIN discusses pooled representation bottlenecks and interest intensity; it does not establish this local intervention or its utility. No novelty claim.

Author README confirms category, brand and behavior type but no item histories. Use only those supplied fields and causal ages; no item match, DMR auxiliary supervision or exact reproduction claim. Publisher paper remains unavailable through the supplied source.

Retain exact local fine-age means, coarse joint action-age histogram and empirical-product category/brand summaries. Append a 64-coordinate diagonal action/fine-age moment; shrink first dense layer to match active nonstatic capacity approximately. Pair observed moments with moments from N[g,a,s]*N[g,s,k]/N[g,s], preserving both complete conditional margins before aggregation over s. No new event inputs.

Frozen reference uses pooled embedding means and independent content/context moments, plus field norm and identity statistics; no explicit fine action-age joint readout. Proposed count-based branch adds that relationship without restoring event category/brand embedding consumers. This does not claim the relationship explains the reference gap.

inherited_components: Frozen six-day full-population training, three epochs, batch 4096, history limit 128, natural class ratio, seed 42 and host validation scorer.
All static embeddings (dimension 16), four nonmissing target-match partitions, log-scaled n/category/brand/joint match counts and observed 4x4x4 group/action/coarse-age histogram.

Group-local mean action plus log2-age embeddings (33 bins) and 28-coordinate empirical-product identity head from g2-r0014-local_product; zero-initialized residual output, unchanged loss/optimizer/lr.
Exact integer-identity entropy/collision implementation with two sorts; no pair sort, new labels, event selection, temporal folds, installation or local training.
study.proposed_difference: Compute observed N[g,a,k] and conditional expected E[g,a,k]=sum_s N[g,a,s]*N[g,s,k]/N[g,s] from the same supplied visible prefix. After selecting observed or conditional counts, append 0.5*sum_(a,k) count[g,a,k]*(action_embedding[a] Hadamard recency_embedding[k])/max(n[g],1). Both cells compute both count alternatives before selection, have identical parameter shapes/allocation/initialization and the same dense width, and are trained from scratch. First hidden width is chosen by the inherited active nonstatic capacity rule; for 18 fields width=484, h=139, active nonstatic=77512 versus local_product=77831 and frozen reference active target=77617. Only observed-vs-conditional is the clean information contrast; comparison with the old parent also changes parameter placement. No verified architectural priority claim.
predictions: Observed counts preserve action/fine-age association that the conditional replacement removes. Exact raw group/action/coarse and group/coarse/fine margins are preserved, including fine bins straddling coarse boundaries; numerical diagnostic errors should be <=1e-4.

On a deterministic collision witness, both cells have identical parent features and identity summaries; conditional moments coincide while observed N[g,a,k] differs. Population moment differences must be nonzero to make the contrast informative.

If association is useful under this readout, fine_action_observed should exceed fine_action_conditional in full-population validation AUC under paired training, with local_product as an existing capacity/cost anchor. Secondary logloss may disagree and will be reported.

A candidate is only an efficiency prospect if measured training seconds remain at least 10% below g1-r0012-joint_identity and AUC is within a prospectively chosen 0.0005 retention margin; inference throughput, latency and memory are separate outcomes, not assumed improvements. Screening criteria do not establish equivalence.
falsifiers: If observed does not outperform conditional in repeatable paired comparisons, this implementation provides no support for useful action/fine-age association; if both beat the parent similarly, marginal recoding/parameter placement is the leading explanation.

If conditional-margin, padding, empty-history, sequence-permutation or direct event-vs-count checks fail, reject implementation interpretation and repair before scientific comparison; failed execution is not scientific counterevidence.
If observed differs on the witness only because a retained base statistic changes, or actual observed-vs-expected moments are zero, the intended attribution is invalid.

Failure of AUC retention or measured cost threshold rejects this implementation as an efficiency candidate; it does not prove compression impossible. A single-seed gain is preliminary and cannot establish a mechanism or noninferiority.
alternative_explanations: Additional bilinear optimization paths and nonlinear recoding may help without unique joint information; conditional replacement provides a same-shape readout control.

Parent comparison changes first-layer width, feature scale and initialization; only the new paired cells hold these fixed. Count matching does not match all function classes, optimization geometry or FLOPs.
Coarse-conditional independence is an explicit deterministic replacement, not a shuffle; expected values may smooth finite-sample associations and are not unbiased causal effects.
Prior local/factorized AUC differences and near-null pair statistics are single-seed evidence; initialization, validation selection and calibration differ, including on empty histories.
Mean diagonal products see only selected projections of the association and can fail even when other fine temporal relationships matter.
Allocated training cost is dominated by static embeddings and host feature gathering; extra count aggregation may eliminate any runtime advantage or increase inference latency.

contrasts.intervention: fine_action_observed: append diagonal moment using observed group/action/fine counts.
contrasts.control: fine_action_conditional: append the identical moment using the coarse-conditional empirical product; reuse g2-r0014-local_product as the no-extra-readout anchor, g2-r0014-local_joint and g1-r0012-joint_identity as existing identity/strong reference anchors.
held_fixed: All data, causal visibility, masks, supplied histories, labels and host scorer.
Static and action/recency embedding allocation, two identity sorts, target partitions, base features and identity summaries.
Both count alternatives computed, selected tensor shape, moment normalization (0.5), output width/hidden dimensions and all trainable parameter shapes/initialization.
Scratch recipe, optimizer, loss, lr=0.001, three epochs, seed42 and full sample coverage.
remaining_confounds: The observed/replacement distributions differ in more than one moment of the same removed dependence; this attributes utility to the supplied association through this readout, not to a particular causal process.
Same operation shapes do not guarantee identical measured device runtime.
First-run validation differences and source-supplied diagnostics require paired repetitions and source scrutiny; no held-out test or bootstrap interface is available here.
Comparisons with historical parent/reference have different parameter placement and no matched wall-clock allocation; report training passes plus measured cost, not an equal-compute claim.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: Keep the cheaper observed-summary candidate only if its quality/cost is promising; reserve paired seeds42/43/44 for selected candidate, conditional control, local_product and frozen joint_identity before any stronger retention/mechanism claim. A subsequent falsifiable question is whether action-specific coarse conditioning, recency resolution or another diagonal readout explains the gain.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain null/negative records. If both branches improve equally, investigate marginal nonlinear recoding; if observed costs too much, test a lower-width aggregate only when useful within remaining budget. If both fail, do not infer that action/time dependence is absent.
